fact_rationales.F10: Heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components is more typical of Central Giant Cell Granuloma
fact_rationales.F11: Erosion of the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells is more typical of aggressive lesions like Central Giant Cell Granuloma
fact_rationales.F13: Displacement of the inferior rectus without muscle invasion is more typical of benign or less aggressive lesions like Central Giant Cell Granuloma
fact_rationales.F16: Presence of significant multinucleated giant cells is highly suggestive of Central Giant Cell Granuloma or Giant Cell Tumor of Bone
